exposure: timing of birth relative to RSV season
cohort: Premature infants born between 29 and 35 weeks gestational age, who were <=2 years of age at the beginning of the RSV season and admitted to the hospital with clinical findings of LRTI during the season.
finding: Preterm infants with RSV-associated LRTI significantly required more hospitalization, intensive care admission, and mechanical ventilation, with infants <=3 months of chronological age experiencing higher rates and longer durations of hospitalization.
